description: We’re building “Dancing with the SARs” for NASA Space Apps 2026—a Multi-SAR platform turning satellite radar data into clear insights on environmental change. I focus on Next.js, frontend, architecture, and data science. We’re looking for teammates in GIS/remote sensing, Python/data science, AI/ML, UI/UX, research, and backend. If you’re curious, collaborative, and ready to build, join us!
